# BTINOX (BT INOX d.o.o.)

> BT INOX d.o.o. (BTINOX) is a Slovenian manufacturer of stainless steel (inox) process equipment, based in Litija with a production hall in Ljubljana. The company designs, fabricates and installs SKID systems, pressure vessels, process vessels, platforms and hygienic piping for the pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, chemical and food industries.

Key facts:
- Legal name: BT INOX d.o.o.
- Headquarters: Kidričeva cesta 6, 1270 Litija, Slovenia
- Production hall: Šmartinska cesta 32, 1000 Ljubljana, Slovenia
- Contact: info@btinox.si, +386 30 391 432
- Languages: Slovenian, English, German
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, EN ISO 3834-2:2021 (welding quality), EN 1090-1 (steel structures, Annex ZA)
- Industries served: pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, chemical, food and beverage (incl. low-temperature honey processing units)
- References (customers we have worked with): Krka, Lek, Novartis, GSK, Novo Nordisk, Pfizer, Takeda, Lonza, Dana, Lactalis
- Core services: SKID systems, pressure and process vessels, platforms and access structures, WIP/CIP/SIP units, bioreactors and fermenters, heating and cooling systems, GMP media piping, pasteurisation units, orbital and TIG welding of stainless steel, mechanical polishing and electropolishing, installation, automation, design, validation and documentation, maintenance
